bridges.title: From proclamation to gratitude
bridges.prompt: How does the same covenantal relationship sound different when it becomes a proclamation and when it becomes gratitude?
bridges.move: Name the shared relationship, then name the new human act the second source requires.

bridges.title: From blessing to standing in prayer
bridges.toSource: Amidah · We give thanks to You
bridges.prompt: What changes when gratitude moves from a response to food into the fixed communal language of prayer?
bridges.move: Distinguish the occasion for a blessing from the structure of a daily service.

bridges.title: From address to agency
bridges.prompt: How can a person petition God and still be addressed as an agent responsible for choosing?
bridges.move: Hold petition and responsibility together without turning either source into the other.

bridges.title: From personal choice to communal setting
bridges.toSource: Jeremiah 29:7 · Seek the welfare of the city
bridges.prompt: What happens to responsibility when a source addresses a community living in a particular city and historical moment?
bridges.move: Move from an individual claim to a public setting while preserving each source’s audience.

bridges.title: From context to conduct
bridges.fromSource: Jeremiah 29:7 · Seek the welfare of the city
bridges.toSource: Pirkei Avot 2:5 · Do not separate from the community
bridges.prompt: How does historical context become an ethical demand without producing a simplistic rule for every situation?
bridges.move: Name the public concern and state one boundary on application.
